description: Look up a single GW1 skill by exact English or official French name, or by template skill id. Returns full stats (energy, activation, recharge, adrenaline, sacrifice), profession, attribute, campaign, elite flag and description. If the name is not found, returns the closest matches so you can correct spelling. Use this when you already know the exact skill; to discover skills by profession, attribute or name fragment, use search_skills instead.

name.description: Exact skill name, e.g. "Mystic Regeneration". The official French name also resolves ("Sceau de guérison" -> Healing Signet); build skill names accept it too; every other name field is English-only.

name: get_skill

isRoleplay.description: PvE-only skill: max 3 per player bar, none on heroes

title: Get a Guild Wars 1 skill
